boundary: Real Rust WASM engine-v5, pinned same-schema JS peer, actual journal/outbox adapters; prepared IndexedDB transactions and copied socket frames; no network or credentials

cases.name: detached and unauthorized local edits remain recoverable; attachment preserves stable anchors and history
disconnect and authorized reconnect replay all local bytes through shuffled duplicate messages without echo
saturated prepared socket pauses bounded send replay and drops no committed local updates
bounded exponential retry exhaustion detaches; explicit reconnect recovers without losing edits
receive frame/count/byte bounds reject before mutation and require a recoverable reconnect
remote, restore and replay journal origins never become outbound update messages
generation fence prevents a delayed old outbox read from sending on a replacement attachment
local commit during a replay read gets a second pass and concurrent pumps share bounded work
transport failure and malformed frames expose errors while local recovery and history remain intact
